promptCommon: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE original full-body adult Yautja civilian WITNESS of the Homeworld galleries as a 2D static game sprite. TWO references: image1 is the official Stan Winston 1987 Predator head and has ABSOLUTE PRIORITY for face/species anatomy; image2 is the game's civic atlas and sets only realistic painterly finish, full-body scale and civilian world style. Do not copy either reference composition or existing person. STRICT CINEMA YAUTJA ANATOMY: broad alien domed cranium, heavy alien orbital ridges, deep-set small eyes, speckled reptilian hide. FOUR DISTINCT EXTERNAL FLESHY MANDIBULAR LOBES around a SEPARATE INNER TOOTHED MOUTH: two upper cheek mandibles with outward ivory tusks AND two substantial lower mandibles with long tusks curving upward. Clearly readable four-part structure in a calm partly open position, not roaring. These are fleshy articulated mouthparts, not two nasal tubes or two hanging fangs. NO human nose, no human lips, no human chin, no human face, no elf/orc face. Thick segmented SCALP TENDRILS, not human hair or ordinary braids. Clawed hands, full reptilian clawed feet. Body in three-quarter view facing RIGHT, face slightly turned back toward viewer so all four mandibles can be read, mildly elevated camera. One quiet standing civilian pose. Unique build and garment architecture in the subject design; ordinary bystander, no uniform, military armour, weapon, skull, royal regalia or poverty caricature. Detailed realistic painted fabric/leather/skin and believable joints/contact where hands hold objects. Full body with all feet and props completely inside portrait, centered with generous clear alpha above head and below toes, aim 8 percent margin. Actual transparent alpha background. NO ground, floor, cast shadow, brown vignette, scenery, extra person, inset, atlas, sheet, text, readable letters, label, border, logo or watermark; omit watermark from the source reference. Native contact shading on body and clothing only. ONE single-pose static sprite.
